findings.title: Existing SQL expression tests will fail against the stubbed DB
findings.body: `TablesList` now always fails, because `NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands` returns "not implemented". `NewSQLCommand` therefore always returns a BadRequest error. Existing tests in `pkg/expr/sql` and `pkg/expr` (e.g. parser tests and SQL command tests) expect table extraction and SQL execution to work, and none of them are updated or skipped in this PR. CI will break, or those tests will silently stop meaningful coverage. They should be removed or skipped, and replaced with a test asserting that SQL expressions are rejected.

findings.title: enableSqlExpressions has dead feature-flag logic and always returns false
findings.body: The function reads `FlagSqlExpressions`, inverts it, and then returns `false` in both branches. The flag lookup has no effect, and the name and structure suggest the toggle still controls the feature. Since the flag still exists and is presumably documented, operators enabling `sqlExpressions` will be confused when it silently does nothing. Make the hard disable explicit, e.g. `return false` with a comment referencing CVE-2024-9264. Also consider deprecating the flag or updating its docs to say it is non-functional.
